assets.name: hero-orbit
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium wide landing-page hero image for MyoSkills, an exercise journey in space. Primary request: an extraordinary sculptural orbital world rendered as high-end 3D editorial artwork, cinematic very wide landscape aspect ratio 16:9. Scene/backdrop: seamless luminous almost white pale lilac #f8f9fe background, subtle diffuse studio atmosphere. Subject: one large floating pearl planet with tactile soft ceramic craters, a violet #7357e8 ribbon orbit and a mint #61e1ca translucent ring crossing in elegant sculptural loops; a few smaller satellite pearl planets and a tiny friendly ivory rocket, giving the feeling of a journey between worlds. Composition: focus the planetary sculpture toward the right half with generous smooth negative space to the left for HTML text; layered depth, orbit in foreground, no excessive objects. Materials: pearl ceramic, satin glass, translucent mint resin, brushed violet metal, precise soft ambient shadows, refined playful sophistication. Color palette: strict base #f8f9fe #dde3f3 #abb5ce #7357e8 #61e1ca #171b36 #303650 #5f6982. Lighting: beautiful soft studio illumination, luminous reflections, subtle iridescence, sophisticated high detail. Constraints: no text, no typography, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no clinical anatomy, no medical devices, no busy starfield; full bleed artwork, light backdrop.
